name: Inference & Optimization
oneLiner: Running trained models quickly and cheaply for real users: serving, APIs, compression and caching.

analogy.text: A restaurant kitchen during service: the recipe is fixed, and now it's about getting many plates out fast and affordably.
analogy.breaks: A kitchen cooks each order separately. Inference servers push many users' requests through the same model step together to use the hardware efficiently.

givesAbove: A fast, affordable endpoint: send text in, get text out.
